leftEvidence.title: Passover desired, bread remembered, and a disputed hand

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: At the table Jesus speaks of desire and fulfillment, gives cup and bread, commands remembrance, names covenant blood poured out, and then identifies a betraying hand at the table.
points.right: Bread and cup are blessed or thanked for, given, eaten, and drunk.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
points.right: The meal speaks simultaneously about what the disciples receive now and a future table not yet present.

payload.posture: Luke and Matthew preserve distinct meal sequences immediately before the arrest.

rightEvidence.title: Bread, cup, covenant blood, and a future table

payload.tension: Luke names desire, remembrance, kingdom, and a betraying hand; Matthew names covenant blood, forgiveness, future drinking, and departure.
payload.title: Desired Passover / covenant cup
